synthetic_source.why: No frozen source states a rating, a scale or a threshold. All of them are required to test headroom and divergence, and none may be invented by the analyst or the core.
consistency_with_frozen_figures: No financial figure is restated: the source names ratios and thresholds only, so it cannot contradict a frozen amount
Metric definitions use the frozen statement row labels: reported EBITDA, total debt, cash interest paid, cash and cash equivalents, levered free cash flow (frozen page:2-4)
FY2025 is the twelve months to December 31, 2025, the base period of CP-1 and CP-2G; terms are tested at fiscal year end as the identity source's 31 December year end implies

Every threshold is far enough from, or deliberately exactly at (boundary fixture only), a figure derived from the frozen pages: FY2025 total leverage 1.67x (50/30), net 1.00x (30/30), coverage 6.00x (30/5), free cash flow to debt 18.0% (9/50)
The issuer is described only by the frozen name; the agencies are fictional (the source says so)

The issuer ratings in this source coexist with CP-3D's unrated instrument: CP-3D's "No rating agency has assigned a rating to the instrument" concerns the quoted bond, while these are issuer ratings of the group; neither statement contradicts the other

Asserted by the builder: page:2 Reported EBITDA FY 30.0; page:3 Cash interest paid FY 5.00 and Levered free cash flow FY 9.00; page:4 Total debt FY 50.00 and Cash and cash equivalents FY 20.00; identity page:1 'Fiscal year end: December 31.'; the recomputed FY2025 ratios (50/30, (50-20)/30, 30/5, 9/50) equal the CP-2G gap T2H.6.a25 facts; no threshold of a non-boundary source equals a FY2025 metric
synthetic_source.parse_rule: page:1 register after the header 'Agency  Instrument  Rating  Outlook  Date' (consecutive five-field lines), page:2 scale after 'Position  Alder Ratings  Brook Credit', page:3 terms after 'Agency  Direction  Metric  Comparison  Threshold'; fields split on two or more spaces; threshold 'N.NNx' (multiple), 'N.N%' (percent, stored as a fraction) or 'Not stated'; a line of two or more fields with another field count makes the source invalid; after a block ends at a line of zero or one field, a later line of two or more fields on that page makes the source invalid; a missing header is an invalid attempt returned alone (s01, s02); a rating of Withdrawn or Not rated has no position (not_applicable), any other rating must be on the scale or the source is invalid ('Rating not on the scale: <agency> <rating>')

edges.decision: D4: methodology.json as is. CP-2H required CP-0, CP-1, CP-2G (rule block); optional CP-1D (rule restricted); no edge_rules entry. CP-2A is not an edge of CP-2H: it is in the plan only because CP-2G requires it.
edges.input_order: execution.current_inputs binds prepared-pack then CP-2H's own required and optional heads in plan order: [prepared-pack, CP-0, CP-1, CP-2G] (CP-1D is unbound in every case)
edges.probe: registry.plan(('CP-2H',)) and registry.plan(('CP-2H','CP-1D')) as listed; registry.step_chain('CP-2H') raises 'CP-2H has no live step contract' (2026-10-28)

positive.execution: closed run: CP-0, CP-1 (five stages, source_context literal with the ratings source), CP-2A (frozen CP-2A positive literal), CP-2G (frozen CP-2G gap literal: CP-1D unbound, minimum liquidity not assessed), CP-2H

gap.execution: closed run as positive with the limited agency source: one threshold Not stated (missing), one agency withdrawn (position, notches, lower rated and outlooks not_applicable)

refused.execution: CP-0 only; CP-1 begin raises NotAuthorized; CP-2A, CP-2G and CP-2H are never begun

blocked.execution: a clone of the positive store taken after CP-2G settles and before CP-2H begins (the refusal payloads r01 and v08 mutate the positive submission, so their issues are those on the positive facts and pages); CP-2H attempt 0 invalid (rejected) and attempt 1 invalid (blocked)

cp2g_blocked.submission: cases/cp2g-owner/submissions.json refusals r01 then v13 for CP-2G
cp2g_blocked.execution: closed run to CP-2A, then CP-2G settles blocked; CP-2H begin raises ValueError('Required upstream is unrun, stale or blocked') (edge rule block)

fixture_total_loss.execution: composer only: positive source and the frozen CP-2G fixture_total_loss facts (downside EBITDA zero: leverage missing, coverage a known 0.00x)

fixture_boundary.execution: composer only: the boundary source (a threshold exactly equal to the FY2025 metric): a known zero headroom, not reached

cp1_fact_selection_rule.predicate: fact.table_id == 'T4.10' and fact.label == 'LTM Q4 25 (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31) · <metric>'; exactly one match per metric, zero or several fail
cp1_fact_selection_rule.fact_ids: interface-fact:<sha256>; bound at run time, never literal
cp1_fact_selection_rule.note: the settled values are those of cases/cp2g-owner/manifest.json fact_selection_rule probe (S1 positive promoted CP-1 head); the bridge-less pack of these cases is unprobed

CP-2G.head: the settled CP-2G head of the run (module id CP-2G, status restricted in the frozen gap run)
CP-2G.reader: CP-2H has no reader of its own: it calls the frozen owners.cp2g.cp2g_reader(store, head) (docs/CP2G-OWNER-LEASE.md:67, wider payload) and selects the T2H.6 facts below from its result
CP-2G.facts: T2H.6.<row>.{total_leverage,net_leverage,interest_coverage,fcf_to_debt} for rows a25, b26-b28, d26-d28 (28 facts), selected by literal fact id from the cp2g_reader result
CP-2G.fact_ids: literal (table.row.field assigned by CP-2G); the frozen values are cases/cp2g-owner/expected.json cases.gap and cases.fixture_total_loss (pinned)

run_time_bindings.figure_placeholders: {{FIG:name|token}} -> {<fact_id>|<token>} for CP-1 names (fact_selection_rule); module-fact references {T2R.x.y.z|token} are literal; unreplaced a FIG placeholder is malformed run text (refusal v07)
run_time_bindings.cp0_consumer_rows: positive and gap: CP-1 (the snapshot row), CP-2A and CP-2G (cases/cp2g-owner/submissions.json cp0_consumer_row_cp2a, cp0_consumer_row_cp2g) and CP-2H (submissions.json cases.<case>.readiness_review.consumers[3]); T8 commands Run CP-1, Run CP-2A, Run CP-2G, Run CP-2H
run_time_bindings.cp1_readiness: submissions.json cases.<case>.cp1_readiness (consumer entries CP-2A, CP-2G, CP-2H); markers bound by the frozen run_time_bindings of the CP-2A manifest

tool_use.CP-2H: owner-only step rating_triggers with inputs module_context and a SourceSession over the fixed host mapping (identity, financial, ratings): one ok read_inputs, then ok read_pages covering every cited page; submissions.json cases.<case>.tool_calls is the literal sequence

view_tree_draft.note: a proposal, not an observation: the implementer commits cases/cp2h-owner/cp2h-view-tree.json from a product-settled head; no quote, citations or record_json key at any depth

keys.upstream: [{module_id, status}] for CP-0, CP-1 and CP-2G (CP-1D state unbound)
keys.register: {state: present|absent, source_id, pages: [locator], agencies: [{row, agency, rating, outlook, date, position: int|null}]}
keys.triggers: [{row, agency, direction, metric, comparison, threshold: {ref|null, shown|null, status}}] (terms, not citations)
keys.cp2g: {status, rows: [{row, metrics: {total_leverage, net_leverage, interest_coverage, fcf_to_debt: {ref, shown, status, limitation|null}}}]}
keys.cp1_facts: [{ref, label, period, unit, shown}] referencable CP-1 reported ratios
